description: This file contains functions and types for configuring and discovering self-hosted provider models, including OpenAI-compatible models, with support for prompts, credentials, and default configurations.

methods.name: discoverOpenAICompatibleLocalModels
methods.description: Discovers local models compatible with OpenAI, filtering by environment and model data.

methods.name: applyProviderDefaultModel
methods.description: Applies a default model reference to the given configuration, preserving fallbacks if present.

methods.name: buildOpenAICompatibleSelfHostedProviderConfig
methods.description: Builds a provider configuration object for self-hosted OpenAI-compatible models.

methods.name: promptAndConfigureOpenAICompatibleSelfHostedProvider
methods.description: Prompts user for provider URL, API key, and model, then constructs configuration and credentials.

methods.name: promptAndConfigureOpenAICompatibleSelfHostedProviderAuth
methods.description: Wraps the previous function to return a ProviderAuthResult with configuration and credentials.

methods.name: discoverOpenAICompatibleSelfHostedProvider
methods.description: Discovers a self-hosted provider if not already configured, resolving API keys.

methods.name: buildMissingNonInteractiveModelIdMessage
methods.description: Constructs an error message when a model ID is missing in non-interactive setup.

methods.name: buildSelfHostedProviderCredential
methods.description: Creates an API key credential object from context and resolved API key data.

methods.name: configureOpenAICompatibleSelfHostedProviderNonInteractive
methods.description: Configures a provider non-interactively, resolving API keys and updating configuration.
